answer: In PoA, each agent’s reputation decays with an exponential temporal half-life, so credible influence requires sustained honest service rather than a brief burst of activity. Under EigenTrust matrix factorization, reciprocity-weighted transitivity, and temporal decay, a freshly spawned Sybil identity has near-zero eigenvector centrality and negligible incoming trust; it therefore cannot cross the consensus threshold, even when coordinated through a lotus, pigment, or whisper.
